associations._note: ADDED AT P8 2026-08-08. The +5V rail carries C108 (22 uF bulk) and C109 (100 nF HF) - both wired to +5V in the netlist (net 1: C108.1 C109.1 C110.2 FB201.1 L101.2 R101.1) - but the sidecar had no +5V association at all, so check_pdn reported 'power rail +5V (0.3 A) has no decoupling capacitors'. That was a metadata gap, not a board defect. The served pin is L101.2, the buck's output node: +5V has no IC LOAD pin on it (the load, U201, sits behind FB201 on +5V_DRV), so the point these caps have to hold up IS the inductor output. C110 is deliberately NOT listed - it is Cr in the LM5017 Type-3 ripple-injection network, not a decoupler. schlib's place_ic_with_decoupling only emits IC-pin bypass entries, so if kicad/gen/hk.py ever regenerates this file these two entries must be re-added by hand.
